contribution: Vasco da Gama discovered the direct sea route to India in 1498, establishing Portugal's spice trade monopoly and creating the foundation for Portuguese colonial empire in Asia. His voyage transformed global trade and marked the beginning of European colonialism in the Indian subcontinent.
historical_significance: Da Gama's voyage to India established Portugal's maritime empire in Asia, transformed global spice trade, and initiated European colonization of the Indian subcontinent.
